name: Covera
long_description:
Insurance is one of the last big industries still running on manual work.

Trillions in premium flow through brokers who still have to key the same data into their agency management system (AMS), chase clients for documents, and fill one carrier portal after another.

Every hour spent on manual quoting is an hour not spent selling. Across tens of thousands of brokers, that's billions in revenue left on the table.

Software never fixed it, because the work sits between systems and raters are outdated.

Covera runs it end to end, with AI workflows connected to the AMS, the inbox and 100+ carrier portals. It fits the way brokers already work, so their teams can focus on advising clients and closing business.

In 3 months, Covera went live with 90+ brokers in the US and Europe. Brokers now go from a client's email to a quote in 3 minutes, instead of hours.

Covera is founded by repeat founders Tiphaine Venet and Thibaut Regerat, who previously built and sold Simio, a conversational AI company.
one_liner: Covera gets insurance brokers to quote first and win more business.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder & CEO at Covera. Previously founded Simio, a conversational AI platform for retail enterprises (Samsung, Carrefour, Air France), and sold it in 2024. Before that, VC at Serena, co-leading investments. Educated at HEC Paris and École Polytechnique.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Covera. Previously co-founder/CTO at Simio, building a WhatsApp commerce platform for e-commerce brands. Engineer's degree in Computer Science from CentraleSupélec. Early experience in data science and business intelligence before transitioning to founding companies.
